title: Identify the account ID of the oldest female client who holds a monthly sta
question: Identify the account ID of the oldest female client who holds a monthly statement account and resides in the district with the lowest average salary. Also, return the total amount of all active loans (status 'C' or 'D') issued in that same district.

prediction.sql:
WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    ORDER BY XCL_030 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_client_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON c.XCL_012 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
active_loan_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.XCL_036) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON a.XCL_002 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
)
SELECT 
    ofca.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    als.total_loan_amount
FROM oldest_female_client_account ofca
CROSS JOIN active_loan_sum als;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    ORDER BY XCL_030 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_client_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON c.XCL_012 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
active_loan_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.XCL_036) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON a.XCL_002 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
)
SELECT 
    ofca.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    als.total_loan_amount
FROM oldest_female_client_account ofca
CROSS JOIN active_loan_sum als;

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    ORDER BY XCL_030 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_client_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON c.XCL_012 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
active_loan_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.XCL_036) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON a.XCL_002 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
)
SELECT 
    ofca.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    als.total_loan_amount
FROM oldest_female_client_account ofca
CROSS JOIN active_loan_sum als;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    WHERE XCL_028 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY XCL_028 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_client_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN account a ON c.XCL_012 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON c.XCL_012 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
active_loan_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.XCL_036) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN lowest_salary_district lsd ON a.XCL_002 = lsd.XCL_017
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
)
SELECT 
    ofca.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    als.total_loan_amount
FROM oldest_female_client_account ofca
CROSS JOIN active_loan_sum als;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    a.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    SUM(l.XCL_038) AS total_active_loans
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034 AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'M'
  AND dist.XCL_017 = (
      SELECT XCL_017 
      FROM district 
      ORDER BY XCL_029 ASC 
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1
